mostWorthwhile.text: Following the rubble world through its encounter with the giant and then the passing star was most worthwhile: the two stages made its eventual escape understandable.

leastWorthwhile.text: Nothing was especially confusing or repetitive, though the direct ice capture was a shorter, less involved passage than the rubble world's journey.

surprise.text: The passing star captured some ice but left the rubble world unbound to either star; the explanation linked the difference to their paths and encounter geometry.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary: each encounter followed from the objects' described paths.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see where the starless world and captured ice go next; their contrasting outcomes made the story engaging.
